data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding (closing 2018 balance) was identified in the technical provisions/claims outstanding table. The report images provided did not clearly show an explicit GROSS prior-year reserve movement figure nor a clearly legible narrative sentence quantifying gross prior year development, so prior year development has not been extracted.
data.data_quality_notes: Document provided as images with low resolution for many notes. Opening gross claims outstanding taken from the 'Claims outstanding' / Technical Provisions table (closing 2018 balance = 360,483 in GBP 000  360.483m). Gross written premium taken from the technical account 'Gross premiums written' row (358,987 in GBP 000  358.987m). A clear GROSS prior-year movement (movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding) was not readable in the supplied images; narrative statements in the report that mention 'net releases' or underwriting year results were present but the gross (insurance liabilities) prior-year movement figure required by the instructions could not be confidently located. A claims development triangle appears present in the report (page 29) but the numeric cells were not legible enough to compute prior year development reliably. Where figures were extracted they are in the report's native currency and units (amounts in the report are presented in GBP 000). Prior-year development is therefore returned as null rather than risk returning an incorrect gross figure. If higher-resolution pages (particularly the Technical Provisions note showing the 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' or the claims development triangle) are provided, a precise gross prior-year development amount and per-LOB movements can be calculated.
